articles.model: GPT-6 Astra Medium · Sol source/completeness review
articles.availability_note: Source review follows MIT’s November 19,2026 report and NIH ultrasound background. Nine-day imaging was a synthetic phantom test; the ten-minute chest sweat test and thirty-minute neck-patch cycling demonstration were separate. The cycling patch connected to a portable tablet. These results support a materials advance; clinical effectiveness, longer human use and production outcomes were not independently verified. The full Science paper was inaccessible; MIT’s labelled repository link resolved to an unrelated thesis and was excluded.

articles.model: GPT-6 Astra Medium · Sol source/completeness review
articles.availability_note: Source review follows the EU’s November 20,2026 summit account, joint statement 16174/26 and Costa’s remarks. The proposed youth scheme specifies 100,000 people in each direction, stays up to three years, an aim to apply the agreement by 2028 and an endeavour to make opportunities available by January 2030. Erasmus 2027 and a six-month tuition-fee negotiation goal are separate. Timeline comparisons concern the milestones listed here, not the full cooperation history. The statement establishes announced positions and stages; enacted legal details, applications, actual fees and realised outcomes were not independently verified.
